headline: Ramayana Day 13: ₹28.60 Cr India nett
lede: 7:00 IST: Ramayana Day 13: ₹28.60 Cr India nett
body:
## 7:00 IST — Last day

Through Day 14 the desk has Ramayana at ₹867.6 Cr India nett, ₹1,009.1 Cr India gross, ₹510.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,519.1 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹844.40 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, Scene at ₹2.65 Cr and Donga Naa Koduku at ₹0.66 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. The Times of India is citing about ₹1,000.0 Cr, WION is citing about ₹1,500.0 Cr, The Week is citing about ₹1,500.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹867.6 Cr India nett and ₹1,519.1 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.
